fileSize.why: Source files already over the ceiling when tools/test-file-size.ts landed; an entry only shrinks.

deadCode.why: Orphan modules and unused exports in package and application src/ when tools/test-dead-code.ts landed; an entry only shrinks.

duplication.why: Pairs of files sharing a run of 6 or more normalised lines when tools/test-duplication.ts landed; an entry only shrinks.

clone:packages/play/bin/grade/tap-stall-.why: the 8 lines this pair carried when the gate landed; between the Play and Propose migrations one side had type annotations and only 6 matched, with both sides .ts again the original 8 matched, and typing Play's bins (2026-10-01) left 6

pythonTypes.why: mypy --strict errors (explicit Any refused) per area when tools/test-python-types.ts landed. Pedro, 2026-10-01: real types everywhere, Python alongside TypeScript, so an entry only shrinks, and an area that reaches none loses its entry and must stay at none.

typeDebt.why: Explicit any and non-null assertions per area when tools/test-type-debt.ts landed: the types JavaScript left implicit, written down. Pedro, 2026-10-01: real types everywhere, no explicit any, so an entry only shrinks (it rose once, when the six bundle-hashed .mjs joined as TypeScript), and an area that reaches none loses its entry and must stay at none.

pythonCasts.why: typing.cast calls per area: an assertion mypy takes on trust, the Python form of the as-casts TypeScript's type-debt gate counts. Counted from 2026-10-03 (tools/python_types.py); an entry only shrinks.

py-cast:packages/source/recompile.why: narrowings mypy cannot see when the count began: Pillow pixel access returns a union for every image mode while native-frame.py reads one RGB and one L image (4 calls); game-builds.py narrows rows its earlier steps filled in (3); sound-map.py passes a list or an ndarray its caller chose (2)

deepImports.why: Relative imports into another workspace, counted per importing area when tools/architecture-test.ts began counting them (2026-10-03, after the cheap ones moved to package names); an entry only shrinks.

deep:apps/desktop.why: every target is a command-line module its package does not export: propose bin/plans (bundle.ts, imported by 24 modules), play bin/phone (local-profile.ts) and the play/games runners. Which bin modules are library is the ADR 0002 move into src/ with an export, not a specifier rewrite

deep:packages/propose.why: 48 reach modules no package exports (source/recompile's draw trace and harness, play bin/ and games/, review bin/ and venue-grid); 21 reach exported src modules from files a parallel Propose fixer holds or from bundle-hashed sources (recipe, minus-toys-plan, parked hid-device-pilot), where a rewrite changes engine.sourceSha256 and invalidates prebuilt bundles

deep:packages/review.why: source/recompile/model-draw-trace.ts, which Source does not export: the recompile lane is a bin of Source, and exporting it is the same ADR 0002 decision

deep:tools.why: apps/desktop/src/lane-kit.ts (the desktop has no exports map) and bin modules of review, play and propose that their packages do not export

measuredConstants.why: Literal copies of a measured constant outside its registered file (tools/measured-constants.json), when tools/test-measured-constants.ts landed; an entry only shrinks.

copy:DEFAULT_READY_DELAY_MS.why: NightRunner.java, the Companion's local runner, which Pedro is asked to delete or redesign (its start gate can never pass); the copy goes with that decision

copy:FUSION_POLL_MS.why: device-lane.ts is in the files the parallel Propose fixer holds for this same finding (E15, floors restated); recipe.ts is a bundle-hashed source, so an edit changes engine.sourceSha256 and refuses every bundle built before it

copy:MIN_CONTACT_MS.why: test-hid-trace.ts, in the parallel Propose fixer's files under E15, beside its released floor of 20 that cycle-library.ts states as 33

nodeTests.why: Lane node files (tools/lanes.json) that register no node:test test, per area, when tools/test-node-tests.ts landed; an entry only shrinks, and a new lane file registers its tests.

Converting a file means wrapping its checks in test() with their own names
